title: Tanker fleet growth
summary:
Main
Image reference: assets/2026-10-13_tanker-fleet-growth_img_unsplash-image-983knf8azec_cdfb4f4e523c.jpg
By Eirini Diamantara & Dimitris Roumeliotis
Tanker fleet growth has accelerated considerably over the past two years, marking a clear shift from the unusually restrained supply environment that supported the market earlier in the cycle. Across the main tanker segments, combined fleet capacity has increased from approximately 677.8 mills DWT at the end of 2023 to around 738.9 mills DWT currently, representing growth of roughly 9.0%. However, the expansion has been far from uniform.
